drawings.description: dans la marge et sous le texte, un polygone non convexe aux sommets notés $A_0, A_1, \dots, A_8$ (certains côtés repassés à l'encre plus épaisse), et à gauche un segment vertical portant $A_1$, $A_5$, $A_2$
drawings.notes: Vertices read on a zoomed view, each placed once, every side drawn between the same points: the closed polygon A_1 A_8 A_7 A_2 A_3 A_4 (unlabelled vertex at the bottom) A_5 A_6 A_7, with A_0 joined to A_1 and A_8 (so A_7 carries three sides and A_1 A_8 A_0 is a triangle); the side A_8 A_7 is inked heavy. Labels at \small, beside their vertices as on the page. On the left the vertical segment with three points labelled (top to bottom) A_2, A_5, A_1, its upper half heavier; its middle point lies on the line between its ends. Notes: the side A_3 A_4 has an overinked knot just above A_4 (not a vertex: no label); the bottom vertex is unlabelled on the page, so ten vertices are drawn for the nine labels A_0 ... A_8. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, quatre sommets consécutifs $s_i, s_{i+1}, s_{i+2}, s_{i+3}$ ; les côtés $s_i s_{i+1}$ et $s_{i+2} s_{i+3}$ prolongés en pointillé jusqu'à leur intersection sur l'axe de symétrie ; l'angle extérieur en $s_{i+2}$ est marqué $\theta = \arg \zeta$
drawings.kind: four consecutive vertices of a polygon, with axis
drawings.notes: Vertices s_i, s_{i+1}, s_{i+2}, s_{i+3}; the vertical axis of symmetry (dashed); two dashed lines rising from the sides at s_{i+1} and s_{i+2} to a heavy point on the axis, with an angle arc there; the side s_{i+2} s_{i+3} drawn double; the exterior angle at s_{i+2} marked by an arc and theta = arg zeta. The dashed lines leave the sides near s_{i+1} and s_{i+2} rather than continuing s_i s_{i+1} straight: drawn as on the page.

drawings.description: à gauche : un polygone aux sommets $s_{-1}, s_0, s_1, s_2$, la droite $D_{\sigma'}$ passant par un pt intérieur (le centre) et le milieu du côté $s_0 s_1$, et, plus bas, une droite $D_\sigma$ dirigée vers $s_0$
drawings.notes: Part of a polygon s_{-1}, s_0, s_1, s_2 (and a further vertex left of s_2), the centre marked inside; the line D_sigma' through the centre crossing the side s_0 s_1, a short stroke from the centre towards s_0, and lower down the line D_sigma pointing towards s_0.

drawings.description: Une ligne brisée~: le segment $a_0$ de $s_0$ à $s_1$, puis le segment $a_1$ de $s_1$ à $s_2$, puis l'amorce d'un troisième segment, vertical, au-dessus de $s_2$.
drawings.notes: The segment a_0 from s_0 to s_1, the segment a_1 from s_1 to s_2, and the start of a vertical segment above s_2.

drawings.description: à droite, un croquis : la ligne brisée $s_{-1}, s_0, s_1, s_2$, avec les vecteurs $e_2$ de $s_0$ vers $s_{-1}$ et $e_1$ de $s_0$ vers $s_1$.
drawings.notes: The broken line s_{-1}, s_0, s_1, s_2, with the vectors e_2 (s_0 to s_{-1}) and e_1 (s_0 to s_1) drawn heavy with arrowheads.

drawings.description: à droite, un croquis : la ligne brisée $s_{-1}, s_0, s_1, s_2$ et, en tirets, les axes de $\sigma_1$ (par $s_0$) et de $\sigma_0$ (entre $s_0$ et $s_1$).
drawings.notes: The broken line s_{-1}, s_0, s_1, s_2 (heavy), its vertices placed once. The dashed axis of sigma_1 starts at s_0 and runs up to the right; the dashed axis of sigma_0 crosses the side s_0 s_1 at its midpoint (computed; the dashes pass there on the page), in the direction of his dashes (nearly, not exactly, perpendicular to s_0 s_1). Labels at \small: s_{-1}, s_0, s_1, s_2, sigma_1 beside its axis, sigma_0 on the heavy overinked label by the axis of sigma_0. Still differs: a second, lighter sigma at the top end of the axis of sigma_0 (its index not legible) is left out; his dashes are irregular, drawn as a regular dashed line. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, deux axes et une droite oblique par l'origine.
drawings.notes: Two axes and an oblique line through the origin (heavy point).

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis : les axes, la droite $D$ de direction $a$ portant $s_0$ et $-s_0$, une flèche $a$, et le point $-s_0' = -(s_0 + \frac{1}{2}a)$.
drawings.kind: axes with a line D and points
drawings.notes: Points placed once and every line drawn through them: the origin is the midpoint of s_0 and -s_0, and the line D (heavy, arrowed at its upper end) runs through -s_0, the origin and s_0; the long arrow a comes down from the upper left through the origin (heavy and arrowed in its lower half, slightly bent at the origin, as on the page); the horizontal axis from the origin with 1 at its end; the vertical axis arrowed upwards; the thin line through s_0, roughly parallel to a, ending in a small circle; the point -s'_0 with a tick to the line of a (its foot computed, perpendicular) and a line down to -s_0; the thin stroke rising from the head of a. Labels at \small, -s'_0 = -(s_0 + a/2) written with the equals sign vertical as on the page. Still differs: which of the two long lines is the axis and which the arrow a is partly a reading; the second 1 by the vertical axis and the 0 at the top are placed as seen, their role unclear; the small marks at the upper end of a are left out. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis : les axes $x$, $y$ et les axes obliques $v$, $w$ par l'origine.
drawings.kind: axes x, y and oblique axes v, w
drawings.notes: The axes x, y and the oblique axes v, w through the origin; v drawn heavier.

drawings.description: deux petites figures en haut à droite : un trapèze formé de deux droites horizontales et de deux obliques, puis le même trapèze avec des arcs marquant les angles et un point fortement marqué (une croix) à l'un des sommets inférieurs.
drawings.notes: Above: a trapezium of two horizontal lines (the upper one heavy) and two obliques, with a thin diagonal. Below: the same trapezium with arcs marking the angles and a heavy cross at the lower left vertex.

drawings.description: un cercle, un rayon horizontal, et un court segment épais joignant l'extrémité du rayon à un point voisin du cercle.
drawings.notes: A circle, a horizontal radius ending in a point, and a short thick segment from that point up to a nearby point of the circle.

drawings.description: un petit carré raturé : $X_s$, $X'_s$ et des flèches vers $S$, couvert de traits de biffure.
drawings.notes: X_s and X'_s with arrows down to S, covered by struck loops (drawn grey).

drawings.description: deux arcs se terminant chacun par un point épais, au-dessus d'un segment horizontal marqué à droite d'un trait vertical et de la lettre $H$ (un astérisque raturé à gauche).
drawings.notes: Two arcs, each ending in a heavy point (the left one drawn as two strokes from its point), above a horizontal segment marked on the right by a vertical stroke and H; a struck asterisk on the left (drawn grey).
